artwork_source.kind: AI-generated historical illustration; not gameplay or an archival photograph
artwork_source.setting: Artistic interpretation of Granaderos preparing at a Buenos Aires barracks in 1812
artwork_source.prompt: Create a masterful historical oil-painted illustration for the opening of GRANADEROS, a serious Argentine independence strategy game trailer. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, ideally 1920x1080. Buenos Aires barracks muster at first light, year 1812: three young adult cavalry recruits in the LEFT half of the image, stern and human, seen waist to full body in three quarter side view, quietly checking leather equipment beside one saddled brown horse. Accurate EARLY mounted Granaderos uniform, as interpreted from municipal museum documentation: plain straight dark blue military coats, a single row of nine small white/silver buttons, restrained red collar/cuff piping, NO modern broad red 18-button ceremonial bib; dark tall shakos with subtle GREEN plumes and GREEN cord (not modern red plumes), raw natural leather shoulder straps, dark blue riding trousers and tall black leather boots. One flintlock carbine held muzzle up; sabre remains sheathed. Modest whitewashed barrack arches in the background, dusty courtyard, worn leather, weight and texture. The RIGHT half is quiet atmospheric warm dark umber/navy space with soft barrack wall shadow and light mist, reserved for clear trailer typography which will be added separately. Do not put any letters, words, flags, banners, logos, map, border, or watermark in the image. Style: cinematic Argentine nineteenth-century history painting, expert natural anatomy and convincing horse anatomy, sober heroic mood, expressive loose oil brushwork, aged canvas texture, dramatic low sunlight in ochre and muted pale blue, charcoal/navy shadows, restrained vermilion accents, finely controlled silhouettes, sophisticated museum painting rather than toy-like videogame concept art. Not photographic footage, not glossy fantasy, no modern guns, no modern uniforms, no exaggerated muscles, no cartoon figures. Historical artistic interpretation, quiet anticipation before the campaign; no battle spectacle, no violence.

actions: Select the ordinary firearm targeting mode with F.
Target Soldado realista 1 and fire the Charleville with Enter.
Reload with the ordinary Alt+R shortcut and consume one reserve cartridge.

actionEvidence.before: 3. Lorenzo Barcala. Salud 85, 15,75 puntos de acción, energía 81, moral 62. Ve 3 enemigos. Mano principal: Charleville. 1 carga(s). 12 de reserva · Cartuchos de mosquete. Disparo activo. Estado 100%. Segunda mano: ocupada por el arma de dos manos. Botón derecho: equipo del combatiente
actionEvidence.setup: In a fresh San Lorenzo skirmish, complete the ordinary first enemy turn with Fin del turno and resume any interruptions through Continuar turno enemigo. Barcala starts the second player turn with 30 PA by retaining five. Select Barcala, choose Run with R and issue a normal movement order from T35 to U44 before the recorded interval. Recenter and pan the native camera. This move clears the convent roof and foliage and leaves enough PA for fire and reload. Cabral fell during the preceding real enemy turn.
